entities.summary: Vyacheslav Dimitrovich Zavalnyuk, is a Ukrainian retired professional ice hockey player. He played for multiple teams during a career that lasted from 1990 until 2007. He also played internationally for the Ukrainian national team at several World Championships, as well as the 2002 Winter Olympics.
